rubric_hint.rule: 1 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: The notification is a 0.6 ha regeneration felling in Sala (polygon 0.72 ha). Completed felling overlaps 9.1% of the polygon (felled 2012).
No eligible species is recorded within 250 m. The only red-listed record there is the mobile NT bird Dryobates minor (75 m, 200 m uncertainty, 2017). Birds are supporting evidence only.

One eligible site-bound VU species is recorded beyond 250 m: the vascular plant Goodyera repens, 799 m away, with 4 records, the latest in 2022, at 25 m uncertainty. Its listed threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness in tree-covered land. This places it in the 250-1000 m ring, so the rubric gives MEDIUM.
Effort is adequate (413 records, 89th percentile). Near-site recording within 250 m is 4 records on 1 day, and none inside the polygon. That is thin, though the county median there is 0.

uncertainties: The eligible record is nearly 800 m from the polygon edge. Whether similar habitat extends to the site is unknown.
Near-site recording is only one day, so the absence of eligible records within 250 m is weak evidence.
The small polygon (equivalent radius 48 m) has 9.1% of its area previously felled, which may affect what habitat remains.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the polygon.
That the site is free of threatened species. Absence of records is not absence of species.
next_action: Reviewer should check whether the habitat around the Goodyera repens records at about 800 m extends toward the polygon. They should consider a short field visit before felling starts.
